parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId value as the ClientToken value. The RequestId value may be different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the flow log.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/132080.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
流日志所属地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/132080.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the flow log.

The name can be empty or 1 to 128 characters in length, and cannot start with http:// or https://
parameters.help_zh:
流日志的名称。

名称可以为空或长度为1～128个字符，不能以http://或https://开头
parameters.name: flow_log_name

parameters.help_en:
The description of the flow log.

The description can be empty or 1 to 256 characters in length, and cannot start with http:// or https://
parameters.help_zh:
流日志的描述信息。

描述可以为空或长度为1～256个字符，不能以http://或https://开头
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance ID
parameters.name: cen_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the project that stores the captured traffic.

The project name must be 3 to 63 characters in length, and must start and end with a lowercase letter or digit. It can contain only lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh:
存储捕获流量的Project名称。

Project名称长度为3~63字符，必须以小写字母或者数字开头和结尾，只能包括小写字母、数字和短划线（-）
parameters.name: project_name

parameters.help_en:
The name of the Logstore that stores the captured traffic.

The Logstore name must be 3 to 63 characters in length, and must start and end with a lowercase letter or digit. It can contain only lowercase letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (_)
parameters.help_zh:
存储捕获流量的LogStore名称。

Logstore名称长度为3~63字符，必须以小写字母或者数字开头和结尾，只能包括小写字母、数字、短划线（-）和下划线（_）
parameters.name: log_store_name

parameters.help_en:
The status of the flow log. Valid values:

Active: activated.

Inactive: not activated
parameters.help_zh:
流日志的状态。取值：

Active：已启动。

Inactive：未启动
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for paging queries. Minimum value: 1. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的条目数。最小值：1。默认值：20
parameters.name: page_size

fields.help_en:
The tag key of the resource.

The tag key cannot be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 64 characters in length, and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

You can specify up to 20 tag keys at a time
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签键。

一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。最多支持64个字符，不能以`aliyun`或者`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https:// `。

一次最多支持输入20个标签的标签键
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value of the resource.

The tag value can be an empty string or up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

Each tag key corresponds to one tag value. You can specify up to 20 tag values at a time
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签值。

标签值可以为空或输入不超过128个字符的字符串，不能以`aliyun`或者`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https:// `。

每一个标签键对应一个标签值，一次最多支持输入20个标签键对应的标签值
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The tag information.

You can specify up to 20 tags at a time
parameters.help_zh:
标签信息。

一次最多支持输入20个标签信息
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en: The capture window duration of the flow log. Unit: seconds. Valid values: 60 or 600. Default value: 600
parameters.help_zh: 流日志捕获流量的捕获窗口时长。单位：秒。取值：60或600。默认值：600
parameters.name: interval

parameters.help_en:
The version of the flow log.

When a flow log is created, the latest version supported by the system is automatically used. The current version is 3
parameters.help_zh:
流日志的版本。

创建流日志时自动使用系统支持的最新版本，当前为3
parameters.name: flow_log_version
